div.div: ORTHOGONALITY PRINCIPLE: The five shock channels compose independently -- 2³ x ∞² combinations (3 binary toggles x 2 continuous parameters). Each shock can be activated in isolation for sensitivity analysis, or combined into multi-shock scenarios (as in the Romania winter case study). The modular design means adding a new shock type requires only: (1) a YAML parameter, (2) an apply_* or add_* function in romania_winter_stress.py, and (3) a UI control in the dashboard.
